paragraphs.text: 1. WITH all thy beauty come: the kine approaching with full udders follow on thy path.
paragraphs.original: आ याहि वनसा सह गावः सचन्त वर्तनिं यदूधभिः
paragraphs.translit: ā yāhi vanasā saha gāvaḥ sacanta vartaniṃ yadūdhabhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Come with kind thoughts, most liberal, rousing the warrior's hymn of praise, with bounteous ones,
paragraphs.original: आ याहि वस्व्या धिया मंहिष्ठो जारयन्मखः सुदानुभिः
paragraphs.translit: ā yāhi vasvyā dhiyā maṃhiṣṭho jārayanmakhaḥ sudānubhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. As nourishers we tie the thread, and, liberal with our bounty, offer sacrifice.
paragraphs.original: पितुभृतो न तन्तुमित्सुदानवः प्रति दध्मो यजामसि
paragraphs.translit: pitubhṛto na tantumitsudānavaḥ prati dadhmo yajāmasi

paragraphs.text: 4. Dawn drives away her Sister's gloom, and, through her excellence, makes her retrace her path.
paragraphs.original: उषा अप स्वसुस्तमः सं वर्तयति वर्तनिं सुजातता
paragraphs.translit: uṣā apa svasustamaḥ saṃ vartayati vartaniṃ sujātatā
